lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15 high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a structured grid posterior to the gill region, organized into four vertical columns and three horizontal rows within the primary visible flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a regular geometric grid where blobs serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature runs horizontally along the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior surface and shadow on the inferior surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin is visible in the lower central frame, displaying a high density of smaller-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank pattern.
